added_observations.metric: Publisher net revenue including rights
added_observations.scope: French book publishers in the SNE statistical survey, including domestic and export activity; paper and digital; net of returns and discounts; includes book sales and rights licensing; not retail consumer spending or audiobook-specific revenue
added_observations.evidence_locator: Printed p.2, PDF page 3, Graphique 1: Evolution du chiffre d’affaires des editeurs; purple revenue bars, 2022–2025
added_observations.notes: All four values taken from the same 2025–2026 report vintage, visually verified. Original EUR million retained. About 150 publishing houses representing about 500 editorial brands in the report; release describes more than 550 brands, so exact brand total is not harmonised. Revenue includes rights; do not compare with book-sales-only measures or treat digital as audiobooks. No computed growth, currency conversion or audience inference. Export activity belongs to the publisher-origin scope; PDF page 22 discusses export sales relative to the same net book-sales total. These are not sales solely to French residents.
